verdict.rationale: Grok Build is a coding agent that can run commands, tests and log monitors in the background (e.g. `/loop 5m Check if the test suite passes and report any failures`, monitors that watch logs or CI runs). Plan mode explores the codebase before editing, and session snapshots let you restore files to an earlier state. Together these support reproducing an issue and verifying a fix, but no evidence describes a debugging or root-cause workflow; that part of the story is only implied by general agent capabilities. Missing for 10: documented debugging/root-cause analysis workflow, explicit issue-reproduction guidance, independent hands-on corroboration of debugging effectiveness.
